name: Monroe County, NY
findings: Monroe County has 2,706 nonprofit organizations. 1,422 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,176 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Monroe County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 56 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 23 in similar places of this size.
